provenance: ADR-028: `press` sends one key to the resolved element (or to the page when no target is given). It changes state the way a click does, so it carries a click's obligation: an authored `expected_state`, enforced by the verifier's unverified-state-change guard, which this milestone widens from `click` alone to every state-changing verb — `press` and `go_back` included. Enter on a text field is the commonest un-clickable submit there is.
